data.name: Hirbad
data.gender_notes: Hirbad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'hirabah' meaning 'fortress, castle'. It is a strong and protective name, reflecting the strength and resilience of those who bear it. The name Hirbad carries the meaning “Fortress, Castle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hirbad usually hope their child will grow to embody fortress, castle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the symbolism of protection, strength, and resilience.
data.etymology: Hirbad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fortress, Castle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hirbad total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: ہرباد

data.cultural_impact: The name Hirbad carries a sense of strength and fearlessness, attributes that are highly valued in Islamic culture. In a time when Islam was spreading across new territories, names like Hirbad were given to remind the bearer of their responsibilities as a Muslim – to protect and defend their community, their faith, and their traditions against external threats.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hirbad carries a deeper meaning – it is a reminder of the fortress that is our faith. In the Quran, Allah says, "Allah is the Protector of those who have faith: He brings them out of darkness and into light. And as for those who disbelieve, their protectors are Taghut (false deities), and they bring them out of light into darkness. Those are the rightful inheritors of the Fire: they will abide therein forever" (Quran 2:257).
